def facts():
    s = CALL.upload(DEV, Q)
    f16 = FM.for_port(DEV, s, np.float16, (2, 32, 64), kt.TensorSpec.make((2, 32, 64))) == s.addr
    spec = kt.TensorSpec.make((64, 64), "mx7a", {"gm": 16, "nk": 1})
    FM.for_port(DEV, s, np.float16, (2, 32, 64), spec)
    key = next(k for k in s.valid if k[0] == "mx7")
    s.free()
    return {"f16": f16, "rows": key[3], "cols": key[4]}
